definitions.gloss: nice to meet you, please treat me well
definitions.explanation: Used when meeting someone for the first time, often after はじめまして. Full form is よろしくお{願|ねが}いします.
Used when asking someone to do something or take care of something.
Used when asking someone to pass along greetings.

examples.japanese: はじめまして。{田中|たなか}です。よろしく。
examples.english: Nice to meet you. I'm Tanaka. Pleased to meet you.

examples.japanese: よろしくお{願|ねが}いします。
examples.english: Thank you in advance. / Pleased to meet you.

examples.japanese: {山田|やまだ}さんによろしく{伝|つた}えてください。
examples.english: Please give my regards to Mr. Yamada.

notes: よろしく is an extremely versatile expression. It comes from the adjective よろしい (good, fine). The polite form よろしくお願いします is essential for business and formal situations. It can be used when meeting someone, ending an email, or asking for a favor.
